title: Spectral Analysis Chamber: Ancient DNA Extraction Lab
description: The user operates a futuristic chemistry lab where they must extract and analyze ancient DNA from a mosquito preserved in amber. Using a damaged containment helmet as a reaction vessel and a dispersion prism as a spectral analyzer, the user calibrates wavelengths, adjusts reagent concentrations, and sequences molecular bonds through a multi-step interactive protocol.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 that implements an interactive 3D chemistry lab scene. Load three GLB models: MosquitoInAmber.glb placed at center on a lab platform as the specimen, DamagedHelmet.glb positioned to the left as a pressurized reaction chamber with a translucent energy dome effect around it, and DispersionTest.glb to the right as a spectral dispersion analyzer. Use OrbitControls for camera navigation starting at position (0, 3, 7) looking at origin. Add ambient light intensity 0.4, a directional light from above-right, and colored point lights near each station that change during interactions. Implement these sequential interaction steps with parameter validation: Step 1: Click the amber specimen to begin scanning, triggering a rotating wireframe overlay and displaying a temperature readout panel in HTML overlay. Step 2: Use a slider to set extraction temperature between 60-85 degrees Celsius; only 72-78 is valid, showing green confirmation. Step 3: Click the helmet reaction chamber to transfer the sample, animating a glowing particle stream from amber to helmet using a BufferGeometry point cloud. Step 4: Adjust a pH slider from 1-14; valid range is 6.8-7.4, the helmet material emissive color shifts from red through green to blue based on value. Step 5: Click the dispersion prism to begin spectral analysis, animating rainbow refraction beams using line segments with gradient vertex colors emanating from the model. Step 6: Use a wavelength slider 380-780nm to isolate the DNA absorption peak; valid target is 520-560nm, the prism glows brighter as you approach correct value. Step 7: Click a Sequence button that only enables when all parameters are valid, triggering a final animation where all three models connect via animated luminous arcs and a double-helix DNA strand made of small spheres spirals upward from center. Display a status panel tracking completion of each step with checkmarks. All sliders and buttons should be HTML elements positioned as an overlay panel on the right side.
